description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.

summary.one_liner: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio for cloning voices, generating speech with multiple TTS engines, and dictating into any app with Whisper speech-to-text.
summary.what_it_does: Clones voices from a few seconds of reference audio and generates speech through eight TTS engines (Qwen3-TTS, Qwen CustomVoice, Qwen VoiceDesign, LuxTTS, Chatterbox Multilingual, Chatterbox Turbo, TADA, Kokoro), covering 23 languages. It provides a global dictation hotkey with Whisper-based transcription, a Captures tab that stores audio and transcripts, and a Stories multi-track editor for conversations and narratives. Generated audio can be processed with pedalboard effects such as pitch shift, reverb, and compression, and long text is auto-chunked with crossfades. It exposes a REST API and a built-in MCP server so agents like Claude Code or Cursor can speak in a chosen voice, transcribe audio, and list profiles. A bundled local Qwen3 LLM powers optional voice personalities and transcript refinement.
use_cases: clone a voice for text-to-speech narration
dictate text into any application with a hotkey
give an AI coding agent a spoken voice
generate audiobook or article narration offline
build podcast or dialogue scenes with multiple voices
add speech output to a custom app via REST API
how_to_run: brew install just  (or cargo install just)
notable: Local-first: models, voice data, and captures stay on the user's machine
Eight switchable TTS engines with different language and style strengths
Built-in MCP server letting agents speak, transcribe, and browse captures
Global dictation with push-to-talk and macOS accessibility-verified auto-paste
Built with Tauri (Rust) rather than Electron
caveats: Linux pre-built binaries are not yet available; build from source is required there
Automatic paste into focused fields is currently macOS only; Windows and Linux auto-paste is on the roadmap
Some engines are limited to English, and only Chatterbox Turbo interprets paralinguistic tags
